citations.title: Mobile App Privacy Policy
excerpts: ## 5\. **How we use AI, and who provides it**

The App uses outside AI services to turn recordings into transcripts and coaching. Before any recording is sent for AI processing, the App asks for your explicit permission. If you do not agree, recordings are not sent to these providers.
Who is the provider, what it receives, and what it does:
* [Amazon Web Services](https://aws.amazon.com/transcribe/) (Amazon Transcribe) - Audio recordings - Converts speech to text and separates different speakers within a single recording

* [Anthropic](https://www.anthropic.com/) (Claude API) - Transcript text and related tour details - Produces summaries, coaching feedback, scores, follow-up drafts, suggested next steps, and answers to your questions

**Limits on these providers.** Our providers process App content only to deliver these features to us. SalesMail does not build or train AI models, and we do not permit our providers to use App content to train or improve theirs.

basis.reasoning: The app privacy policy directly names Amazon Transcribe from Amazon Web Services for transcription and Anthropic’s Claude API for summaries, coaching, scores and related AI features.
